name: Garron Paduk — Vétéran Gears 5

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: ONE static transparent full-body costume reference for Garron Paduk — Veteran Gears 5, costume id paduk_skin_02.
Target edition: Gears 5 (2019) campaign, older silver-haired Paduk. The supplied image is the actual Gears 5 character model published by its artist Kenneth Doyle, with three views of the SAME person. Use those views only as reference; output exactly ONE complete figure, never a lineup. Preserve his older heavy lined face, short brushed-back silver hair, deep burn scarring on the right side of his face and right upper arm, massive stocky physique and tired stern expression.
Match the visible costume: sleeveless olive-green and dark steel UIR chest armor with TWO round raised breast plates, distressed yellow stripe/stenciling and small service ribbon bars on his left breast; bright small blue square lights on the shoulder harness; tan brown wrapped scarf around the neck; diagonal olive strap from his right shoulder to his left waist, circular tan canteen at left waist; broad dark tactical belt with round blue center buckle, dark brown cargo trousers, asymmetric thigh holster and utility pouches, large dark armored right forearm cuff, smaller left wrist band, padded fingerless tactical gloves. Reconstruct the unpictured lower shins and boots conservatively as practical dark armored combat boots matching the suit; do not invent prominent badges or readable text. Preserve visible scarring as healed scarring, no open wounds.
Pose: calm neutral full-body standing at front three-quarter facing screen RIGHT, nose and toes directed right; both empty relaxed hands visible down at sides. No carried weapon, no combat action, no animation.
Framing: one whole character, entire hair, hands, legs and boot soles visible, at 75% of image height with at least 10% clear transparent margin on all sides.
Rendering: realistic Gears 5 game character materials and source proportions, clear neutral studio illumination, genuine transparent alpha background. No environment, floor plane, smoke, halo, ground shadow cloud, vignette, watermark, label, UI, or added text. No younger Judgment Paduk, no Major Paduk variant.

sources.scope: Modèle Gears 5 publié par Kenneth Doyle, artiste de la tête et du corps ; trois vues jusqu'aux cuisses, armure dorsale Mindwalk, cheveux Doyle et Can Etiskol. Édition explicite.

observations: Un seul Paduk âgé, cheveux gris, cicatrices guéries, foulard brun et armure UIR à deux disques ; bras nus et tenue cohérents avec la référence Gears 5.
Plein pied fixe de trois quarts vers la droite, mains vides.
Jambes basses et bottes absentes de la référence : reconstruction générative documentée. Les coutures, semelles et fermetures ne sont pas validées.
Les stencils jaunes, rubans et petits insignes sont approximés ; ne constituent pas une transcription canonique vérifiée.
Le visage et les cicatrices sont une reconstitution générative. Fidélité 1:1 non certifiée.
Alpha RGBA réel : 64.76% de pixels entièrement transparents ; alpha maximal bande extérieure de 8 px : 0.
Marges de silhouette alpha >=128 (gauche, haut, droite, bas) : [190, 46, 203, 35] px ; anatomie complète, marges cibles de 10% à contrôler.
remaining_checks: Comparer bas de pantalon, protections et bottes à une capture Gears 5 complète.
Valider asymétries, détails des rubans, boucle et proportions avec le modèle natif.

notes: Référence originale Gears 5 ; aucune référence au jeune Paduk Judgment ou au costume Major Paduk.
